findings.issue: Pointwise design 'kills position bias by construction' overstates. Style-first is correct per the one controlled study but inherits single-study fragility the draft elsewhere treats as disqualifying.

findings.suggested_fix: Soften to 'removes the pairwise order-swap surface; retains scale/serial-position biases covered by X audits.' Keep swap-consistency >=0.80 and length/self-preference gates, but scope the <=0.04 claim to its study design and require the close-call pairwise path to report dual-order disagreement rates rather than averaged-away scores.

findings.counter_evidence: comparisons.md Tension 2: two loci independently converged on temperature-scaled MaxProb as floor (SetFit-routing via Varshney-2022 'nothing consistently beats MaxProb'; escalation via 200809371-towards-improving-selective-prediction-ability-of-nlp-systems + investigating-selective-prediction-approaches-across-several-tasks-in-iid-ood-an + on-the-evaluation-of-neural-selective-prediction-methods-for-natural-language-pr on refinement/AUGRC 240701032-overcoming-common-flaws-in-the-evaluation-of-selective-classification). Convergence is presented as corroboration; neither investigator nor draft discusses that routing and escalation then share one failure mode. Supporting caveats in-draft (dropout-as-a-bayesian-approximation underestimates uncertainty; scaling calibrates without reordering; 210600170-adaptive-conformal-inference-under-distribution-shift breaks exchangeability) all point the same way: a miscalibrated MaxProb fails open at both stages at once.
findings.issue: Unified MaxProb doctrine is sold as independent convergence when it is also a single point of correlated failure: the same overconfident score routes to the LLM and, ANDed with NLI, governs auto-handle. A misordered MaxProb both misroutes and mis-escalates, and the NLI gate (near-0.9 veto) catches grounding failure, not intent misranking. The draft pre-registers challenger contests but no disagreement/diversity analysis between the two stages.
findings.location: Section 4 ('One doctrine serves routing and escalation... Full-layer 10-pass dropout therefore routes only if it beats temperature-scaled MaxProb') + Section 6 ('Temperature-scaled MaxProb is the floor...') + Section 10 Phase 2/4
findings.suggested_fix: Add a correlated-failure diagnostic to the contest: joint confusion of router-abstain vs escalation-abstain, margin/entropy challenger features evaluated on discordant slices, and a requirement that any challenger show wins specifically where MaxProb is confidently wrong (not just AUGRC overall). State the reversal: divergent signals mandatory if joint-failure rate exceeds a pre-registered bound.
